Evidence & scope

Three claims. Three boundaries.

LIVE · SAME ORG

Inert recreation proven

Retained Claims evidence records a real same-org inert recreation with independent readback and backup/restore. It does not prove operational activation or real cross-org portability.

SYNTHETIC · DISTINCT ORGS

Workflow qualified

PR #67 exercises the real local planner, service, SQLite/R2 and restricted CLI with fictional Cedar/Willow identities and provider effects. That is the class of every product screen here.

REAL CROSS ORG · NOT RUN

The next proof is explicit

Authorised real second-org GET admission and exact native qualification remain outstanding. No real Genesys mutation or product deployment was performed for this showcase.

Screens are genuine captures. Original PR #67 evidence is retained alongside new captures of the IPI-branded UI. Different capture takes have different programme IDs, timestamps and labels. The unknown-response scene is a separate synthetic native-shaped fixture.
